parallel_growth_points.title: Import six reviewed Ashr server-side grading rows into calibration.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Customers trust gates more when local failures match official grading.

parallel_growth_points.title: Replace offline llm_judge references with audited live model-call summaries.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Audited semantic evidence supports high-value false-positive review.

parallel_growth_points.title: Convert incident summaries into reviewed regression candidates.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Incident replay is a direct enterprise painkiller after agent failures.

parallel_growth_points.title: Group failures by class, scenario family, SDK language, and owner role.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Teams pay for root-cause grouping, not only pass/fail rows.

parallel_growth_points.title: Capture judge override, waiver, and reviewer notes as calibration inputs.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Human review feedback makes the judge improve with customer use.

parallel_growth_points.title: Ship prod, staging, regulated, and experimental release policy templates.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Per-team policy templates increase enterprise fit and deal size.

parallel_growth_points.title: Expose waiver approvals, reviewers, reasons, and evidence refs in reports.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Managers need sign-off history before accepting release gates.

parallel_growth_points.title: Compare policy, taxonomy, scenario, and judge versions across runs.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Versioned judge history answers why scores changed after upgrades.

parallel_growth_points.title: Mark cases that disagree across local, official, and semantic judges.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Flaky-case isolation lowers false block risk for paying teams.

parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Media-capable agent products need image and artifact evidence checks.

parallel_growth_points.title: Capture official API error/quota/status shapes as public-safe fixtures.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Real error semantics make the clone more faithful than guesses.

parallel_growth_points.title: Break judge and semantic cost ledger down by tenant/project/run.

parallel_growth_points.title: Define industry packs with owners, difficulty, tags, and review status.

parallel_growth_points.title: Publish A2 dashboard-ready fields for gates, waivers, regressions, and costs.

parallel_growth_points.title: Make release gate blockers actionable as PR annotations with owner hints.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: PR gates enter the customer's release workflow where budget is justified.

parallel_growth_points.title: Track precision, recall, mismatch, and drift by failure class over time.
parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Judge quality metrics reduce buyer fear of false positives.

parallel_growth_points.commercial_value: Customer incidents become compounding regression assets.
